ops.body: RE + design complete (2026-07-14, claude 2.1.209 inspected): full doc in ccn doc 426ee43. Key facts: claude vendors proper-lockfile verbatim — mkdir-DIR lock at <configDir>/.oauth_refresh.lock, stale=10s, mtime touch every 5s, NO PID anywhere (mtime is the only liveness signal), plus a second legacy sibling lock <realpath(configDir)>.lock acquired new→legacy, released legacy→new; per-call single-shot with 5×(1-2s) caller retries; refresh re-reads tokens UNDER the lock and tombstones on invalid_grant under the lock. CORRECTION to this task's 2026-07-13 comments: claude's LOGIN save path (installOAuthTokens→N8t) does NOT take the lock in 2.1.209 — the shared lock closes refresher-vs-refresher (this task's double-spend class) but does NOT close the login-vs-install window in installEnvelope/InstallSyncedCredential; the empty-proof + CAS stays the guard there. Design highlights: new internal/pool/claudelock.go mirroring the dialect exactly; the mtime-updater goroutine is MANDATORY (cc-pool's 15s refresh POST timeout exceeds claude's 10s stale threshold — without touching, a live claude would break OUR lock mid-POST and re-create the double-spend in reverse); integration at Manager.refresh (the single token-spend point) with an under-lock re-read mirroring claude's own; contended → ErrRefreshDeferred, self-heals next poll. Implementation queued behind the v0.56.0 landing (usage.go conflict avoidance).
